resumeText:
Sneha Iyer | Hyderabad | sneha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Verification Engineer, Godavari Semiconductor Design, Hyderabad (2020 - present)
- Built UVM agents, sequences and scoreboards for an AXI4 interconnect IP.
- Wrote the verification plan and closed functional and code coverage for two IP releases.
- Debugged RTL failures from nightly regressions using Synopsys VCS and Verdi waveforms.
- Added SystemVerilog assertions for FIFO overflow and handshake checks.
- Automated regression triage with Python scripts that bucket failing seeds.
- Ran regressions on Linux servers through LSF.

SKILLS
SystemVerilog, UVM, AXI, AHB, VCS, Python, Linux, Digital electronics

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, JNTU Hyderabad, 2020
